# IS1200 Lab 4 - Assignment 1 ALU test vectors
# Pins must be named exactly: A, B, F, Y, Zero
# F: 000=ADD, 001=SUB, 010=AND, 011=OR, 101=SLT (signed)
# <DC> = don't care; Zero is only specified for ADD/SUB.

A[32] B[32] F[3] Y[32] Zero

# --- ADD / Zero ---
0x00000000 0x00000000 000 0x00000000 1
0x00000005 0xFFFFFFFB 000 0x00000000 1
0x00000005 0x00000003 000 0x00000008 0
0xFFFFFFFF 0x00000001 000 0x00000000 1
0x7FFFFFFF 0x00000001 000 0x80000000 0
0x80000000 0x80000000 000 0x00000000 1

# --- SUB / Zero ---
0x00000005 0x00000005 001 0x00000000 1
0x00000005 0x00000003 001 0x00000002 0
0x00000000 0x00000001 001 0xFFFFFFFF 0
0x80000000 0x00000001 001 0x7FFFFFFF 0
0x00000003 0x00000001 001 0x00000002 0
0xFFFFFFFF 0xFFFFFFFF 001 0x00000000 1

# --- AND ---
0x00000003 0x00000001 010 0x00000001 <DC>
0xF0F0F0F0 0x0FF00FF0 010 0x00F000F0 <DC>
0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 010 0x00000000 <DC>

# --- OR ---
0x00000003 0x00000001 011 0x00000003 <DC>
0xF0F0F0F0 0x0FF00FF0 011 0xFFF0FFF0 <DC>
0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 011 0xFFFFFFFF <DC>

# --- SLT, signed / two's complement ---
0x00000000 0x00000001 101 0x00000001 <DC>
0x00000001 0x00000000 101 0x00000000 <DC>
0xFFFFFFFF 0x00000001 101 0x00000001 <DC>
0x00000001 0xFFFFFFFF 101 0x00000000 <DC>
0x80000000 0x00000000 101 0x00000001 <DC>
0x7FFFFFFF 0xFFFFFFFF 101 0x00000000 <DC>
0xFFFFFFFF 0xFFFFFFFF 101 0x00000000 <DC>
